text: Royal Caterpiles (Japanese: , Roiaru Kyapiru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Caterpile family, and can be found at level 74 in the Windy Cave on Bionis' Leg. They are the only enemies that drop Caterpile Silk, which is required for Colony 6 Reconstruction, as well as the Replica Monado 1 quest.
Rock Krabble Shells are rare materials in . They are dropped by various low-level Krabbles in Colony 9, and can also be traded for.

Royal Kromar Pikes are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various Kromars in Eryth Sea and Brutal Gravar in Makna Forest. Royal Kromar Pikes are otherwise not available. According to their description, only royalty may possess them and while they are dignified, they are tiny in size.

Roly Poly (Japanese: , Korobe mo) is one of Riki's Ether debuff arts in . It has a 30% chance of Toppling an enemy, but cannot topple enemies more than 10 levels higher than Riki. If the topple fails, Bind will be inflicted instead.
Sabre Drones are Mechonis Drones in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be obtained from one shop.

This quest is easily missable and will expire after the events at the Mechonis Core. Roof Battle (Japanese: , Okujō no Kessen) is a Timed Surprise Quest in . It is triggered upon arrival at the Training Ground Roof in Central Factory. This location is reached by riding the elevator between Central Gate on the ground floor and Central Lift on the second floor, and jumping to a platform on the north side as the elevator passes it. At the north end of this platform is a ramp leading up to the Training Ground Roof.

This quest will expire if Romantic Notions of a Boy is completed instead. Romantic Notions of a Girl (Japanese: , Ren'ai Jōju: Josei-hen, Love Fulfilment: Female Edition) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from Monica at the Military District, north of the Weapon Development Lab in Colony 9, once Tephra Cave is accessible after the Mechon have attacked Colony 9. This quest's objective is to obtain the Tephra Drop found inside Tephra Cave. If Melia is in the active party, she will comment. Talking to Andreas after this quest is accepted will trigger Romantic Notions of a Boy. Both quests being mutually exclusive, only one of the two quests can be completed, as they both require the Teph
The Sacred Flower is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Yusa in Frontier Village during Healing the Healer.

This quest will expire if Romantic Notions of a Girl is completed instead. Romantic Notions of a Boy (Japanese: , Ren'ai Jōju: Dansei-hen, Love Fulfilment: Male Edition) is a Timed Quest in . It can be received from Andreas in the Military District of Colony 9, once Romantic Notions of a Girl received by Monica has been accepted and once Tephra Cave is accessible after the Mechon have attacked Colony 9. It involves retrieving the Tephra Drop to give to Monica. Both quests being mutually exclusive, only one of the two quests can be completed, as they both require the Tephra Drop. If Reyn is in the active party, he will comment. If the party chooses to accept Romantic Notions of a Boy - which

Safer Energy (Japanese: , Anzen'na Enerugī ni) is a quest in . It can be received from Gadada at the Pollen Works in Frontier Village. It is only available if Gadada was chosen to be Dobadoba's apprentice during The Master's Successor (A route). This quest and Distilling Active Ingredients are mutually exclusive. If Dunban is in the active party, he will comment.
The Sacrificial Tablet is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is required for The Path of Bafalgar, and can be found on the Path of Absolution in Tephra Cave.

Royal Apis Nectar is a rare material in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be obtained from various Apis in Makna Forest near Bridge Three. Royal Apis Nectars are also available for trade with Kokora. According to their description, they are only eaten by the Apis queen, but her minions often sneak a little taste. Two are needed for one route of Popularity Premonition.

Sabulum Orlugas are enemies in . They are members of the Orluga family, and can be found at level 33 in Makna Forest. Several of them can be found south of Windmill Pavilion intermingled with Scout and Bois Hodes. They can drop the Fancy Orluga Masks needed for Material Quest 2.

Rufus Control Units are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by Orluga Rufus in the High Entia Tomb or traded for in Alcamoth with Ruthan. According to their description, they are machine control mechanisms that have many intricate parts. Three of them are needed for Getting a Member's Card.
Rusty Parts L are common materials in . They can be dropped by Mechon M82 or traded for with Arda.
Rusty Parts S are common materials in . They can be obtained from various Mechon on the Bionis' Leg and in the Ether Mine, or by trading with Dulland
Rusty Parts M are common materials in . They can be obtained from various Mechon on the Bionis' Leg and in the Ether Mine, or by trading with Pama.

The Sabre (Japanese: , Guntō) is a unique weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is Dickson's weapon, and cannot be removed from him nor used outside of the time he is in the party. Using the knowledge and techniques he gleaned while wandering Bionis, Dickson developed the Sabre himself. It consists of a rifle with a large blade built into it. Its two gems are Unbeatable VI and Topple Resist VI, both with a 100% value.
The Sage's Food is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is received from Pipiki when accepting Meeting the Nopon Sage, to be used as an offering to the Nopon Sage.

The Rustpool Banks (Japanese: , Akasabi Ikegun) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Noctilum, to the immediate north of the path to Primordia. The Rustpool Banks BC is located here. The red ponds are poisonous, and sap 15 health every second.
Rubidium Oc-servs (Japanese: , Rubiji Me-Tsuu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Oc-serv machines, and can be found at level 23 at Suncatch Ravine in Noctilum.
The Roof Rock (Japanese: , Rūfu Rokku) is a landmark in . It is located in Primordia, north of East Gate Plain, east of New Los Angeles.

Roderick, the Fleet-Footed (Japanese: , Shikku no Roderikku) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Evello family. It can be found at level 11 in Primordia on the East Gate Plain during the day. It is usually running back and forth with a Quick Evello. Unlike the other nearby evello, Roderick will lunge at attackers to stagger them. Defeating it is required in the eponymous basic mission Roderick, the Fleet-Footed.
Rust Lake (Japanese: , Akasabi Kosui) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Noctilum, next to Old Dragontail Tree.

Rock Potamuses (Japanese: , Rokku Hippo) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Potamus family, and can be found at level 11-12 at Biahno River (both the headwater and a pond downstream) and western Sayram Lake, and level 16-17 at Janpath Lake in Primordia.
Roscoe (Japanese: , Rosukoru) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Central Industrial District in New Los Angeles. He is a member of the Curators division.
The Roof Rock BC (Japanese: , Rūfu Rokku BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia. The camp is operated primarily by the Outfitters.
Ruby Forfexes (Japanese: , Rubī Pagurusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Forfexes and can be found at level 22-23 near Bloodpond Basin in Noctilum.
Rock Simius (Japanese: , Rokku Shimiusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Simius and can be found at level 21-22 or at level 25-30 at East Gate Plain in Primordia.
Sacred Progen (Japanese: , Seikuriddo Ekuusu) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Progen family and can be found at level 46-48 at the Decapotamon in Noctilum.

Rogue Ovis (Japanese: , Pasutā Owisu, Pastor Ovis) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Ovis family, and can be found at level 21-23 in Primordia, on the rocky slope on the east side of South Janpath Plain during the day.
Saffron Saltats (Japanese: , Kanarī Sarutāto, Canary Saltat) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Saltat family, and can be found at level 31 in Molten Hollow in Primordia.
Ruby Saltats (Japanese: , Rubī Sarutāto) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Saltat family, and can be found at level 51-53 on Fallshorn Isle in Primordia.

Sabulas (Japanese: , Sabueru) are sand-dwelling worm-like creatures in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in sandy areas in Noctilum, Oblivia, and Sylvalum. Sabula Tyrants are colossal and often Hidden.

The Rustpool Banks BC (Japanese: , Akasabi Ikegun BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a BLADE base camp run by the Reclaimers, located in Noctilum's Rustpool Banks near the entrance from Primordia.
The Rowdy Potamus (Japanese: , Rōdi Hippo) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Potamus and is fought at level 31 at Sickle Rock Rise in Primordia during Emotion Commotion.
The Ruins on the Sandbank (Japanese: , Nakasu no Kodai Iseki) are a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are located in Oblivia, above the King's Falls. A Lifehold can be found nearby.
Rutantan is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Hangar in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.
Ryo is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is Human, and can be found working atop a crate just outside the Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District.

Rosie Kellington (Japanese: , Rōjī) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found near Water Purification Plant in the Residential District of New Los Angeles during the day. She can be found later at the Biahno Water-Purification Plant of in Primordia during the day, where she is a staff member and works as the "Data Analyst".

Rockmole's Burrow (Japanese: , Iwamogura no Su Iriguchi) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a cave located in Noctilum, northeast of and above FN Site 218. Although it can seem difficult to access due to the entrance passage being full of numerous aggressive enemies, the main cave area itself only contains three low-level Blattas and non-aggressive (although much higher levelled) monsters. It also contains a high concentration of Collectibles and the FN Site 224.
Rooney Cavern (Japanese: , Wein Sekkutsu, Wayne Rock Cave) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Oblivia, to the far south of the Leaning Ring.

The Ruins on the Butte (Japanese: , Byūto-jō no Kodai Iseki) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Oblivia, at approximately the center of Aaroy Plain. It is primarily inhabited by Prone.

Sadelana Lettuces (Japanese: , Sadirana Retasu) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia. Four heads of Sadelana Lettuces are required for the Normal Mission The Journey Begins.
Sacrificial Reactors (Japanese: , Pureriaru Riakutā) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia.
Royal Grapes (Japanese: , Roiyatsume) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia.
Ruge Daikons (Japanese: , Ruge Daikon) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum.
Rods of Brutality +10 (Japanese: , Zangyaku no V-Roddo) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros.
Rolf, the Sonorous (, Bisei no Rorufu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Saltat family. It can be found at level 44 in Oblivia south of King's Falls.

Rodriguez, the Twin-Tusked (, Sōga no Rodorigesu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Potamus family. It can be found at level 35 northeast of Emerian Battlegrounds in Cauldros. It must be defeated with the Sparkjet Rifle during What the Skell?!.

Roimi, the Affluent (, Kinkō no Roimi) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Blatta family. It can be found at level 31-35 at Janpath Lake in Primordia at night, crawling high on a tree, the tallest one located between the two spots from where Luciel, the Eternal takes drinks.

Ruth, the Shunner of Light (Japanese: , Dankō no Rūsu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Unafulge family. It can be found at level 42 above the magma in the Secluded Lava Lake in Sylvalum.

Sadar, the Unhinged (Japanese: , Kyōran no Sadā) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Marnuck Ganglion member. It can be found at level 35 at Hilal Stronghold in Sylvalum at night. It is located two buildings east of FN Site 409 at the rooftop. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Sadar, the Unhinged.

Sadar's Qmoeva (Japanese: , Sadā Sen'yō Kumūba) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Qmoeva Ganglion's Skell. It can be found at level 44 north of the FN Site 417 in Sylvalum on top of one of the western triangular ledges during daytime. It will appear inactive until approached. It is the Qmoeva of Sadar, the Unhinged.

Saffron Arenatects (Japanese: , Kanarī Rorongu) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Arenatect family, and can be found in the Cinderdunes at level 41-44 or at level 49-50 in Sylvalum, submerged in the sand.

Rust Blattas (Japanese: , Rusuto Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family, and can be found at level 1-10 in Cauldros, northwest of FN Site 505 during non-clear weathers. Four must be defeated during Blatta Splatter.
Saffron Germivores (Japanese: , Kanarī Burōsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Germivore family, and can be found at level 31-40 in Noctilum, near FN Site 224.

Ryyz's Silver Piercings are prime materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained after defeating Ryyz, or purchased using 162 Reward Tickets. They are components in crafting most of the bunny suits.

SN333: Jisanne (English dub: , Japanese: , SN333: Jisānu) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She appears on Primordia's South Janpath Plain during the mission A False Hope. She is then battled shortly afterwards.

SG002: Slenna (Japanese: , SG002: Suren) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Definian and is fought at level 40 at Anvil Sandplain in Sylvalum during the Normal Mission Good Fortun.
ST816: Stalio (Japanese: , ST816: Sutario) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Definian and appears in Cauldros, where the party battles her.

Rotund Caro (Japanese: , Puranpu Nokkusu) are six Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Caro family. They are fought at level 27-29 at Sandsprint Slope in Sylvalum during the Affinity Mission Soldier of the Harriers.

The Running Shark (Japanese: , Furīshāku) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Human-Made Skell piloted by Otis and is fought at level 21 at Middle Hushflood in Noctilum during My Dream.

Rocket Shrads (Japanese: , Roketto Zuttā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Shrad machines, and can be found at level 41-50 on the aerial bridges connecting the Forgotten Mining Frigates in the north part of Cauldros, specifically near FN Site 510 and the Abandoned Bivouac. They sometimes roll off the edge of the bridge, or may be knocked off the bridge during a battle.
Saiden (English dub: ) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at Division Drive in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.
Ruinous Devil Wings are a casual head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They look the same regardless of who wears them, and share their appearance with the other Devil Wings armor.
Run'tonam is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is an Orphean.
Running on Empty is a Soul Voice in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It may trigger when a character's Skell Fuel drops below 30% in combat.

Roselle is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be first found in Primordia at Seaswept Rise during A Dubious Operation. After completing this mission, if route A has been chosen, she will disappear because she has been arrested, if route B has been chosen, she will be found at the Central Industrial District in New Los Angeles.
Rocky Research is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a geologist and the primary destination is Sylvalum.
Rocky Lagoon BC (Japanese: , Ōiwa Shōko BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be found a short was southeast of FN Site 505 in Cauldros. The camp is operated primarily by the Reclaimers.
Rugged Skins are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Millesaurs, Vigents, and Coronids.
Sabula Backbones are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Sabulas.

S.P. Units are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Duran's Galdr, or for 90 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Max GP Drive augments.
Sabula A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a brown sabula variant. It can be obtained from Squallo, the Sand Mirer in Oblivia.
Sabula B is a Holofigure in . It depicts a white sabula variant. It can be obtained from Atreides, the Distinguished or Gesserith, the Wileworm in Sylvalum.
Sacrifole A is a Holofigure in . It depicts a blue sacrifole variant. It can be obtained from Dobromila, the Alluring in Sylvalum.
Sacrifole B is a Holofigure in . It depicts a silvery sacrifole variant. It can be obtained from Angelita, the Blade Bouquet in Cauldros.
Sacrifole C is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a red sacrifole variant. It can be obtained from Vegetal, the Heatcrux in Cauldros.

Saber Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Sakuraba Industries Photon Saber. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Curios category of the Noctilum Collectopedia. The Saber weapons available in-game are: * Archetype Saber * Iron Saber * Carbide Saber * Cermet Saber * Chrome Saber * Chromoly Saber * Cobalt Saber * Titanium Saber * Ceramic Saber * Diamond Saber

The SENJU is a Skell Weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Its models are only obtained as a reward for completing the Time Attack Mission The Wrothian Samurai. It resembles the bident used by the Deva Caladar.
Ruthless Uniforms are Casual Wear full-body armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries.
|-|M120 Model= |-|XXM120 Model= |-|M150 Model= Rods are sidearms for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Colubrims or Oc-servs.
Rotten Meat are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained by defeating Lunar Gradies or Cruz Paguls, or by trading.
Rough Skins are common materials in . They can be obtained from Mell Lizards, Tephra Lizards and Singing Brogs in Tephra Cave, or traded for with Minnie and Oleksiy, the latter only in Colony 9.

Run'tonam's Right Arm is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is dropped by Telethia, the Endbringer during one route of A Fateful Choice. It is the right arm of Run'tonam, having been swallowed by Telethia.
Sachair is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian salvager who can be found at Goldmouth Return Port in the Argentum Trade Guild.
Rumbletum Canteen (Japanese: , Harapekko Shokudō) is a shop in . It is located at the Rumbletum Canteen in the Argentum Trade Guild's Goldmouth. It specializes in Staple Foods.
Rolling Smash (Japanese: , Rōringusumasshu) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts with the Aegis Sword.
Rumbling Smash (Japanese: , Ranburusumasshu, Lit. "Rumble Smash") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Shield Hammer.

Rosa (Japanese: , Sakura) is a boss in . She is a gargantuan Artificial Blade created by Bana based on the blueprints of Lila. She is fought at level 32 in the Old Factory of the Empire of Mor Ardain with Rex and Nia. Once her HP have been slightly reduced, Tora will join the group alongside Poppi QT. An upgraded version of Rosa called Giga Rosa is fought later at the Indoline Praetorium.
Saber Slash (Japanese: , Seibāsurasshu) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using a Catalyst Scimitar.

Ropl (Japanese: , Ryibura) are a family of enemies in the . They are dinosaur-like monsters with two legs and a tail and crystals on their backs. They are similar in build to Aligos, and come in gray and green varieties in . A variety unique to the Kingdom of Torna is pale tan with green crystals. They can appear burrowed in the ground before attacking the party.

Runaway Train Bool (Japanese: , Bōsō Kikansha Buru) is a Unique Monster in . He is a Garlus Driver enemy who can be found at level 55 in Temperantia, on the ramp to the west of the Ardainian Garrison, facing his troop of Garluses. He must be defeated in order to unlock Zenobia's level 4 "Wind Mastery" Field Skill and Perun's level 5 Cold Sever Blade Special. He is fought as a level 108 Challenge Battle Enemy during Humanoid Alliance.
The Saets Chief's Residence (Japanese: , Shubia Zokuchō no Ie) is a Location in . It is located in Torigoth in the Gormott Province, on the side of the pond opposite Abble's Fountain.

The Ruined Laborers' Bridge (Japanese: , Kuchita Rōdōsha no Hashi) is a Landmark in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain. Access to this area can be found on the Lower Level. Head north from Anangham #2 Dock on the lower level until you reach the section with pipes to the east. There is a staircase here. Follow it up until you reach the Ruined Laborers' Bridge.
The Royal Guard Barracks (Japanese: , Invidia Shin'ei-gun Heisha) are a Location in . They are located in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya, between the Fonsa Myma Port and the Holy Gate of Fontana.

The Ruins of Fountain Park (Japanese: , Perura Funsui Kōen Atochi) is a Landmark in . It is located in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya. It is only accessible by skating down the waterslide on the Old Pilgrim's Road and jumping at the end. This place is connected to the Raqura Aquagardens Secret Area, and is involved during Tranquility. Visiting this landmark with Elma, Pyra, Zeke, and Pandoria in the party is necessary to unlock Elma's level 2 Keen Eye Field Skill. There are no enemies here.

The Sacred Ice Caverns (Japanese: , Seiseki no Hyōdō) are a landmark in . They are located on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, north of the Three-Vein Crossroads. They consist of a raised platform with a Treasure Trove upon it above a poison moat.
The Sacred Grove (Japanese: , Seirinchi) is a landmark in . It is located on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, south of Genbu Drifts and north-west of Zalmor's Crevice.

Runo Cave-in (Japanese: , Runo Kanbotsudō) is a Secret Area in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Cliffs of Morytha, within Idora Cave, and leads up to the Path of the Believer. There is a Heart-to-Heart here - "Constants" - alongside three Collection Points and a Treasure Trove containing a Nopon Doubloon.

The Ruins of Judicium (Japanese: , Yūdikiumu Atochi) are a level in . They are located in Temperantia, in the southeasternmost part of the Titan Weapon Dig Site. Nonono can be found here. They contain two weaponized Titans and some old building remains.
The Rumbletum Deeds are a Store Deed in . They can be purchased from the Rumbletum Canteen in the Argentum Trade Guild after purchasing at least one of every Pouch Item sold there.

Roly-Poly Maracas are Instrument Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Strummer Instruments in Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Poppi α. Two need to be used to unlock Poppi α's Level 2 "Noponic Iron" Battle Skill.
Ruska Dumplings are Staple Food Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Tilly Bakery in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
Ruska Noodle Goulashes are Staple Food Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Tilly Bakery in Torigoth in the Gormott Province and from Calceno Deli in the Indoline Praetorium.
Ruska Noodle Soups are Staple Food Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Tilly Bakery in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
The Sadecott Deeds are Store Deeds in . They can be purchased from Sadecott Groceries in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Rumble Cellos are Instrument Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Vibrattio Instruments in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Sadecott Groceries is a shop in . It is run by Mimaira and can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya's Garfont Village. It is specialized in Veggies.
Ruvie is an NPC in . Ruvie is an Urayan who can be found in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. Ruvie runs a shop called Aquaneze Cosmetics specialized in Cosmetics.

Rook Arachnos (Japanese: , Rūku Supaido) are enemies in . They are members of the Arachno family and can be found at level 71-73 on the Upper Level - Right of Gormott Province, particularly on the underground path between Coolley Lake and Varnax's Plunge. They also can be fought at level 56 during the Challenge Battle Call the Exterminators.
Rub-a-Dub-Dub is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at Smùide Hot Spring in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Ruffian Bunnits (Japanese: , Rafian Banitto) are enemies in . They are members of the Bunnit family and can be found at level 69-71 on the Upper Level - Right area of Gormott Province, particularly on the underground path connecting Coolley Lake and Varnax's Plunge.

Ruga Quadwings (Japanese: , Rugā Kurōdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Quadwing family and can be found at level 13 - 17 perched in trees around Coolley Lake and Melnath's Shoulder in the Gormott Province during the day.

Sabri Crustips (Japanese: , Sabari Shuribu) are enemies in . They are members of the Crustip family and can be found at level 3-9 at the Torigoth Relay Base or the Grodd Residential Zone in the Gormott Province after Salvaging.

Ruchik Kapibas (Japanese: , Ryuchika Kapība) are enemies in . They are members of the Kapiba family and can be found at level 31-35 on Baldotas Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago. Five of them must be defeated to unlock Adenine's level 2 "Wind Mastery", Vess's level 3 Thunderstrike, and Patroka's level 2 "Earth Mastery".
Rowda Ignas (Japanese: , Raudā Igūna) are enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 49-53 at the Bastion of Varrac on the Central Plain of Temperantia.

Rooka Ansels (Japanese: , Rurukana Anseru) are enemies in . They are members of the Ansel family, and can be found at level 40-42 at Amphoret Pillar on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal. Three of them are fought at Sekis Pillar during The Home of the Soul in the .

The Ruined Chapel of Danafas (Japanese: , Danafasu Reihaidō Atochi) is a location in . It is located on the Central Plain of Temperantia, west of the Ancient Wall and north of Toxbloom Spring. The Bastion of Varrac can only be reached by navigating the toxic water behind the Chapel.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Round Table Medals (Japanese: , Entaku no Kunshō) are accessories in . They restore up to 5.5% of the wearer's maximum HP every time they successfully cancel an Auto-Attack with an Art. They are the upgraded version of the Chivalric Medal and Military Medal accessories. The DLC exclusive Beatific Medal accessory offers a stronger instance of this equipment's effect.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Rush Hours (Japanese: , Rasshu Awā) are accessories in and . They increase the window of opportunity for cancelling attacks by up to 70%, making the timing required to perform cancels more lenient.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Sage's Auspices (Japanese: , Kenja no Gofu) are accessories in and . They boost the wearer's resistance to the Shackle Driver debuff by up to 100%, allowing for full immunity to the status. They are the upgraded version of the Priestess's Auspices accessory.

Rosary Mosses are Flower collectibles in . They can be found in the World Tree, in particular from the Botany Collection Point directly east of the 7th Perimeter Center Floor on the Mid Level. In the , Rosary Mosses can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo. Five are needed for the quest Farewell, Good Friend in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Rubble Gems are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Land of Morytha.

The Royal Audience Hall (Japanese: , Teosukarudia Ekken no Ma) is a Location in . It is located in Theoscaldia Palace in the Kingdom of Tantal. Eulogimenos and Fortis can be found here. After completing Salvage King, the Orbital Skyreader, Hammershead, Golden Sunstone, and Calamity Puzzle are displayed on the altars behind Eulogimenos's throne.

, A Saffronia Tree]] Saffronias are trees in the , first seen in . They are trees with orange and pink petals growing on their branches. At night, the petals of a Saffronia glow brightly.
